fastpitch 1.0.0 (MIT), a header-only pYIN pitch tracker that matches librosa.pyin
frame for frame. Local repository, commit 6dbbc79ad5f8298efcfd8485404d5490663b1fcf,
unmodified: include/fastpitch/pyin.hpp and LICENSE only.

GigaTune (engine/src/builtin/GigaTuneDesign.h) uses its YIN stage and observation
model (fastpitch::detail::Model and YinWorker) frame by frame, with a streaming
Viterbi decoder of its own over the same HMM: fastpitch's Decoder backtracks only
once the whole signal is in.
